tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind lists and screens. Warm off-white / warm near-black, never pure #fff or #000.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, the Why-it-matches list. Sits on bg with a border hairline, not a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, filter chips, inputs, the tab bar, map pins: things that sit above content.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: unselected segmented track, preference tags, skeleton blocks, nutrition cells, disabled buttons.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines (1px) between rows and around cards. Not used alone to mark an interactive edge.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of interactive controls (chips, secondary buttons, inputs, pins) and slider tracks: at least 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body and titles on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and accent-soft (13:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Metadata, reasons, captions on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (6:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and the unused $ in a price level. Exempt from contrast; never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Herb green. Primary buttons, selected chips, active tab, slider fill, links. As text on bg, surfaces and accent-soft (5.2:1 or more). HSL saturation 29% / 28%.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed primary fill; text on accent-soft in selected chips and the budget readout (7:1 or more).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected chip fill, active tab pill, restaurant thumb, ghost button press.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an accent or accent-pressed fill (6:1 or more). Dark text in the dark theme because accent lightens.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid outline, 2px offset. 5.6:1 or more on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: "Fits you". Teal-leaning green, set apart from accent and from danger by hue toward blue; always with the check-circle icon and the words. Text on surfaces and success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind success text in match badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: "Fits with a swap". Always with the swap icon and the words. Text on surfaces and warning-soft (5.2:1 or more).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning text in match badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: "Doesn't fit", allergen alerts, destructive buttons, severe-allergy tags. Text on surfaces and danger-soft; also a fill under on-danger.

tokens.name: danger-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed destructive button fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger text: doesn't-fit badges, allergy tags, the allergy notice.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a danger fill (severe tag, destructive button): 5.8:1 light, 7.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: "Verified by restaurant" label (with the seal-check icon). Text on surfaces and info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind info text, used sparingly (verification callouts).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims content behind a bottom sheet.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Map illustration base. Map colors are for the basemap only, never for UI text.

tokens.name: map-road
tokens.usage: Map roads.

tokens.name: map-park
tokens.usage: Map parks.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Map water.

families.sans: "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

groups.name: Scale
groups.note: One family, one scale. Sizes are written in rem in code (px here at 100%) so they follow Dynamic Type / text scaling up to 200%. Turn on tabular numerals (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) for every price, distance, walk time, count and nutrition value.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Onboarding headlines and empty screens. At most one per screen. 2rem.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Place and item names at the top of a detail screen. 1.5rem.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings, card titles, sheet sections. 1.125rem.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Chickpeas simmered with tomato, ginger and garam masala.
styles.usage: Running text, menu item names (at 600), input text. Never smaller for paragraphs. 1rem.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Sauce made with cashew cream. Ask for tomato gravy.
styles.usage: Match reasons, metadata lines, sheet hints. 0.875rem.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, tags, segmented options. Sentence case. 0.875rem.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Confidence labels, slider ends, small badges. Smallest text in the app except tab labels (12px, 600). 0.8125rem.

spacing.note: 4pt base, 8pt rhythm. Screen gutter is space-4; sheet gutter space-5.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label inside tags; gaps in tight chip rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; inside controls; icon-to-label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between cards in a list; row padding top/bottom.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen or in a sheet.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty and error state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top breathing room on onboarding steps.

radius.note: One system: pills for anything you tap or that labels, 16 for cards, 12 for inputs and thumbnails, 24 on the top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Skeleton lines and other tiny non-interactive marks.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Search field, text inputs, restaurant thumbnails, nutrition cells.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Restaurant cards, menu groups, Why-it-matches list, nutrition block.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top-left and top-right corners of bottom sheets only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, filter chips, tags, match badges, segmented controls, map pins.

shadow.note: Hairlines first. Elevation only where something floats over content.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and slider thumbs.

tokens.name: shadow-pin
tokens.usage: Map pins and the floating map/list toggle.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target in both dimensions (2.75rem) for every control, including icon buttons, chips and segmented options.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside small tags, badges, chips and metadata.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, rows and inputs.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Tab bar icons.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every border. No 2px borders except the focus ring and the slider thumb.

duration.note: Functional motion only. Under prefers-reduced-motion everything is instant and the skeleton stops pulsing.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Press feedback, chip selection.

tokens.name: duration-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet in and out.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Every transition.
